test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14a1aa1b73950be864701888757cb47445ab4d20862ea6cf2c90b59e941a185d.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The figure in the series moves in the anticlockwise direction facing inside & outside every alternate step & it skips space in every step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b21c4eb5cf08b4949c33f7e2a381fd5a4f7cae916934169292f1af268ecc24d.png] 

Next step: The figure will skip 4 spaces from the previous step and will face outside.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fa66ee16a9be8edf490abf777d47aff4963228e03205877765a8515e977c7b1.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08b320c9e16902f3cb305c804ab39fb877871b5e25186b12f37ac220523c514a.png] The figure skips 5 spaces.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fa66ee16a9be8edf490abf777d47aff4963228e03205877765a8515e977c7b1.png] The pattern is correct.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e31cbd00d4ea6065957b168e6f6f6b64ad49536dc98748bbec61e2b50f7564b.png] The figure slips 5 spaces & faces inside.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a86bd243e53804fc881f2955a79f204e4d34641a60412dd32cea9b18cf94ade4.png] The figure faces inside.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
